parts.headline: The Bubble Is in the Denominator
The Model Is Not the Price

mentions.excerpt: Citing Aswath Damodaran, Silverio says that price would require about $1.2 trillion of annual revenue inside a decade, while everything sold under the AI label adds up to roughly $250 billion today.

Mia Silverio of Prof G Markets, on October 5, set the $2 trillion valuation Anthropic is said to seek against Aswath Damodaran's estimate, which she relays, of an AI products and services market near $250 billion; nearly a quarter of Anthropic's 2025 revenue, by her count, came from two customers, and 47% of sales ran through Amazon and Google.
Citing Aswath Damodaran, she wrote that such a valuation needs $1.2 trillion of annual revenue within ten years, against a current market for AI products and services of about $250 billion.
